title: CNN Vision Lab
lede: A real convolutional network, trained on MNIST and running in your browser. Draw a digit and watch every filter develop like a print in the darkroom: eight edge detectors, then sixteen shape detectors, then the meter swings to a guess. Turn on saliency to see which pixels mattered. Then play the adversary: flip a 98%-accurate model's mind with as few pixel edits as you can.
description: CNN Vision Lab: draw digits for a real in-browser convolutional network, watch its feature maps, see saliency, and craft adversarial pixel edits.
